title: Wheat Berry and Greens Stew
subtitle: with lemon, mint and parsley
description: A hearty wheat berry pilaf-style stew with onion, green chilli and garlic, finished with a big handful of mint, parsley, celery leaf and beet greens.

steps.text: Soak the wheat berries in plenty of hot water for about 1 hour. Drain.
Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over high heat and fry the chopped onion until golden. Add the sliced green chilli and garlic and fry for another minute until fragrant.
Add the wheat and keep frying, stirring, until the grains are coated in oil.
Add the boiling water, reduce the heat and cover the pot. Cook for about half an hour until the grains are tender but not mushy. Add a little more water if needed.

When the wheat is ready, turn off the heat, add the chopped greens and the juice of half a lemon and season generously with salt and pepper. Mix carefully with a wooden spoon and serve warm with thick tahini or seasoned yoghurt.
